description: This file defines internal static methods and fields for instrumenting grain and system target counts using metrics in Orleans. It includes initialization logic, counters for grain and system target counts, and methods to increment and decrement these counters.

classes.name: GrainInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing instrumentation counters and methods for grain and system target counts within Orleans.

methods.name: IncrementGrainCounts
methods.description: Increments the grain count counter for a specified grain type.

methods.name: DecrementGrainCounts
methods.description: Decrements the grain count counter for a specified grain type.

methods.name: IncrementSystemTargetCounts
methods.description: Increments the system target count counter for a specified system target type.

methods.name: DecrementSystemTargetCounts
methods.description: Decrements the system target count counter for a specified system target type.
